newsitem.title: INDIA: India's money supply growth figures worrying-I-Sec.
newsitem.headline: India's money supply growth figures worrying-I-Sec.

text.p: The latest figures for India's money supply growth are a cause for concern, ICICI Securities and Finance Company (I-Sec) said in a report on Wednesday.

"The year-on-year growth in broad money at 16.6 percent is fairly high and the more worrying factor is that most of the monetary expansion has found its way into chasing financial assets, as reflected in the nearly 25 percent rise in banks' investments," I-Sec said in its latest debt market update.
It said the inflationary impact of monetary expansion was largely hidden due to the administered prices of fuel and some essential commodities.

"However, with the increase in minimum support price (MSP) of food items by seven percent to 10 percent and the impending oil price hike, wholesale price inflation is likely to ascend by 100 to 150 basis points over the next few months," I-Sec added.
